## Root-cause recap (from root's browser evidence)
- `after-extended-geometry.json`: 390px + `'Long supplied caption '.repeat(500)` → viewer `image.height = 0`. The viewer frame (`relative min-h-0 flex-1`) collapses under a very long caption inside the `flex-col` body.
- Compiled Tailwind/global utilities contain no `pb-safe` → fullscreen Dialog padding class was silently dead.

## Changes (4 files only)

**`frontend/src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx`** — removed the duplicated fullscreen portal/header/close/body branch; now ONE shared portal + header + modality with variant classes only (no registry/factory). Center/left/right classes and overlay-click semantics byte-identical (`onClick` close only for non-fullscreen; fullscreen keeps no overlay-close). Lock/inert/focus logic untouched. Fullscreen panel keeps `h-full max-h-full w-full min-h-0 max-w-none rounded-none` + body `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`, and `pb-safe` → compiled Tailwind arbitrary `pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` (fullscreen only).

**`frontend/src/components/tour/TourGallery.tsx`** — viewer frame `min-h-0` → `min-h-[240px]` (flex-1 + dialog body scroll retained; full caption stays rendered and reachable, nothing truncated). No observer/measure hook. 15-line narrative comment trimmed to SSR-single-DOM / exact-sizes / focus-boundary rationale; viewer JSX nesting re-indented evenly. `fill`+`sizes`+`object-contain` image usage unchanged per installed Next docs (`fill` needs positioned parent, `sizes` drives `srcset`).

**Tests** — 2 focused structural regressions (unit classes can't prove pixels; root reruns actual browser): long-caption frame keeps `min-h-[240px]` with full caption reachable; fullscreen panel has env safe-area classes and no `pb-safe`. 1 prior frame assertion updated to the intended fixed class.

## Gate evidence (exact outputs)
- **RED (before fix):** `Test Suites: 2 failed, 2 total / Tests: 2 failed, 37 passed, 39 total` — `expect(element).toHaveClass("min-h-[240px]") / Received: relative min-h-0 flex-1 …` and `expect(received).not.toMatch(/pb-safe/) / Received: "… bg-surface pb-safe …"`.
- **GREEN (after fix):** `Test Suites: 2 passed, 2 total / Tests: 39 passed, 39 total` (`--runInBand --watchman=false --forceExit`, ~21s). All 37 prior tests incl. default close/nav regressions pass.
- **ESLint** (4 owned files): `ESLINT_DONE:0`, zero output.
- **Typecheck** (`tsc --noEmit`): 1 error, pre-existing and unowned — `TourBookingController.test.tsx(4,28): error TS2724: '"react-dom/client"' has no exported member named 'HydrationRoot'`; zero errors in owned files.

Root runtime (actual-browser final incl. long-caption 390px re-measure) still pending with root.
